packagesIntro: Pick a short break, a hill escape or an overseas favourite. We can adjust days, rooms, meals and travel pace for your group.
storyHeading: A family holiday should feel like time together
storyParagraphs: Family travel comes with a moving checklist: school holidays, grandparents’ comfort, snacks, nap times and the famous “are we there yet?” We help you turn that list into a workable plan. Choose a slower day, a private cab, rooms that suit your group and stops where everyone can stretch, eat and enjoy the view.

Since 1992, Comfort Journey has helped travellers plan from Bhopal for India and overseas holidays. You can tell us about a child’s food preference, a parent’s walking limit or the room setup you need. We share pricing upfront, help with visas for international trips and stay available on WhatsApp or phone at +91 87704 03315 during your trip.

quickAnswer.question: What makes a family tour package easier to book?
quickAnswer.answer: A family tour package is easier to book when the plan accounts for children, older travellers, meal preferences, room needs and realistic travel time. Comfort Journey can customise India and international itineraries, arrange private cabs with drivers, offer hotel choices from 3-star to 5-star and share the exact quote upfront on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Can you plan a family trip with children and grandparents?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us the ages, walking comfort, room needs, food preferences and the pace your group prefers. We can customise the itinerary around those details.

faqs.q: Can we choose a slower pace for kids and older parents?
faqs.a: Yes. We can build in shorter sightseeing days, rest time and practical stops. The right pace depends on the destination, travel time and needs of your group.

faqs.q: What hotel options do you offer for family holidays?
faqs.a: You can choose from 3-star to 5-star hotels, as well as palaces and villas where available for the destination. We discuss location, room setup, comfort and budget before sharing options.

faqs.q: Are private cabs available for family packages?
faqs.a: Private cabs with drivers are available for your family itinerary. They make meal breaks, rest stops and changes easier to manage, subject to the destination and plan.

faqs.q: How much do family tour packages cost?
faqs.a: The price changes with destination, dates, group size, hotel category, flights, meals, activities and the level of customisation. Share your plan on WhatsApp and we will send an exact quote before you book.

faqs.q: Can you help with visas for an international family holiday?
faqs.a: Yes, visa assistance is available for international trips. Requirements and approval timelines depend on the destination and each traveller’s documents, so we will explain the process for your plan.

finalHeading: Tell us what your family needs
finalText: Send your dates, destination and group details on WhatsApp. We’ll suggest a practical plan and share the quote upfront.
